headline: Base Ledgers Shift on Several Active Fronts
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, Callum’s Cape has shifted further: four Warden bases and three Colonial now stand there, with no neutral, against six Warden and one neutral in the previous account. Seven event rows fell in the latest two hours, though the day’s busiest points remain Scouts Jest, Naofa and Ire. Mooring County now lists ten Warden bases, one Colonial and one neutral; six event rows arrived in the latest two hours. Marban Hollow’s division remains four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral, but its latest two hours were quiet. Weathered Expanse still holds seven Warden bases and two neutral, with no events in the latest two hours. Linn Mercy remains ten Colonial and one neutral; six events came within six hours, none in the latest two. Godcrofts likewise remains entirely Colonial-held, with seven event rows over the day but none in two hours. The war remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
